title: Earned Wage Access Bundle Terms on Reinstatement Fees — Paystride Payroll Card Program
content:
The reinstatement fee of a Paystride Payroll Card Program is multiplied when the employer's Paystride Earned Wage Access program agreement is live today: under the employer-paid fee model — by 0.5; under any other fee model — by 0.8; with no live agreement — the fee is not multiplied under this term.

**Records read.** The employer's Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement: whether its status is live today, and its fee model (worker-paid, employer-sponsored or employer-paid).

| Agreement status today | Fee model | Multiplier of the reinstatement fee |
|---|---|---|
| live | employer-paid | 0.5 |
| live | worker-paid | 0.8 |
| live | employer-sponsored | 0.8 |
| any status other than live, or no agreement | any | none |

Hypothetical figures: a reinstatement fee figured at 82.40 for an employer whose agreement is live under the worker-paid fee model is multiplied by 0.8, giving 65.92; under the employer-paid fee model it is multiplied by 0.5, giving 41.20. An agreement that is suspended today carries no multiplier under this term.
